prompts.cover: Use case: text-localization. Edit supplied original and approved M7-01 cover reference into the next series cover. Preserve deep navy textured background, luminous cyan/green bottom ribbon, lower-left feather emblem, right-aligned large white title, left negative space, overall landscape aspect about 1.805:1. No extra illustrations or diagrams. Bottom-right tagline exactly “一个真实系统七端实战”. Crisp correct Chinese typography. Replace old headline and series line with the specified text; do not retain M0-01 or M7-01. Headline two lines “Markdown” / “编辑器实战”. Series line “M7-14｜成为全栈·Vue 管理后台篇”.
prompts.editor-workflow: Use case: infographic-diagram. One landscape Chinese technical blog interior infographic, aspect about 1.805:1. Reference images define the approved series style: deep royal navy blue, clean white Chinese typography, cyan-to-green borders, very subtle luminous bottom ribbon and small feather emblem lower left. Use generous spacing, clear readable short labels, restrained flat cards. Mark with article ID and “示意图”. No fake screenshot, no evidence of passed tests, no checkmarks, no invented brand logos. Only show the specified content. Preserve exact identifiers, correct Chinese. Title “编辑内容，走完保存链路”. Subtitle “M7-14 · 示意图”. Flow of four major cards “新建空稿 / 详情回填” → “编辑与本地校验” → “创建或更新请求” → “服务端返回文章实体”. Below final node two connected outcomes “更新 saved，清除 dirty，失效文章缓存” and “新建成功：替换为编辑路由”. Small note “保存保留现有状态；发布、审核、下架遵循契约”. Do not invent state transition arrows between draft/rejected etc.
